name: Noxiptiline
aliases: Agedal, dibenzoxine, Elronon, Nogedal, Noxiptilinum, NOXIPTYLINE
summary: Noxiptiline (brand names Agedal, Elronon, Nogedal), also known as noxiptyline and dibenzoxine, is a tricyclic antidepressant (TCA) that was introduced in Europe in the 1970s for the treatment of depression. It has imipramine-like effects, acting as a serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor, among other properties.

pharmacology.text: It has imipramine-like effects, acting as a serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor, among other properties.

uses.text: Noxiptiline (brand names Agedal, Elronon, Nogedal), also known as noxiptyline and dibenzoxine, is a tricyclic antidepressant (TCA) that was introduced in Europe in the 1970s for the treatment of depression.

sideEffects.en: Like other tricyclic antidepressants it can cause dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, drowsiness and dizziness on standing. Tricyclics can disturb the heart's rhythm, and overdose on them is dangerous.
sideEffects.zh: 與其他三環抗憂鬱藥一樣，它可能造成口乾、便祕、視力模糊、嗜睡與站起時頭暈。三環類藥物可能擾亂心臟節律，過量時相當危險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与其他三环抗忧郁药一样，它可能造成口干、便秘、视力模糊、嗜睡与站起时头晕。三环类药物可能扰乱心脏节律，过量时相当危险。

fact.en: It is a tricyclic antidepressant in which the side chain is joined to the ring system through an oxygen atom, an unusual oxime ether link.
fact.zh: 它是一種三環抗憂鬱藥，側鏈透過一個氧原子與環系相連，形成少見的肟醚連結。
fact.zhHans: 它是一种三环抗忧郁药，侧链通过一个氧原子与环系相连，形成少见的肟醚链接。
